description: This file defines two classes, PixelShuffle and PixelUnshuffle, which implement tensor rearrangement operations for super-resolution tasks in neural networks, including their initialization, forward pass, and representation methods.

classes.name: PixelShuffle
classes.description: A module that rearranges tensor elements to upscale spatial resolution by a specified factor.

classes.name: PixelUnshuffle
classes.description: A module that reverses the PixelShuffle operation to downscale spatial resolution.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Executes the tensor rearrangement for upscaling or downscaling.

methods.name: extra_repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the module's configuration.
